starshipEstimatedLaunch.summary: SpaceX has not posted an official Flight 14 date. Ship 41 completed single-engine and six-engine static-fire testing on August 19-20, and current launch tracking places the first orbital Starship attempt no earlier than September. The previously discussed upper-stage tower catch has shifted to a later flight.

stories.title: NASA's Starling satellites demonstrate GPS-free autonomous navigation
stories.summary: The FALCON experiment used onboard cameras and a catalog of space objects to determine Starling's orbit without GPS or ground navigation. Over three days it also improved orbit estimates for more than 200 tracked objects, a step toward autonomous lunar satellite swarms and better collision avoidance.

stories.title: NASA's Roman telescope clears its flight-readiness review
stories.summary: NASA and SpaceX certified the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope to proceed into final launch preparations, targeting no earlier than 7:26 a.m. EDT on August 30 aboard Falcon Heavy. Roman's wide-field surveys are designed to study dark energy, dark matter, exoplanets, and the universe's evolution.

stories.title: Hubble identifies a major merger from the Milky Way’s infancy
stories.summary: Hubble measurements of 39 inner-Milky-Way globular clusters, combined with Gaia data, isolate a third cluster population that points to an ancient collision with a dwarf galaxy dubbed LKH. The result pushes definitive evidence of the Galaxy’s assembly history about 1.8 billion years farther back, to roughly 11.8 billion years ago.
